description: Abort a pairing you started with register_agent. Works while pending and after approval: an already-approved connection is revoked (the API key stops working) so a pairing approved by the wrong account can be undone. Available until the pairing expires, and for 15 minutes after you pick up the API key; later than that, use revoke_self. Then call register_agent again.

claim_token.description: The claim_token returned by register_agent (authorizes the cancellation)

pairing_code.description: The pairing code returned by register_agent

name: cancel_registration
